summary: Clamp the integer pointed to by a1 into the inclusive range [a2, a3]: if *a1 is below the lower bound a2 it is raised to a2; if it is above the upper bound a3 it is lowered to a3. Returns the original *a1 value, read before any clamp. Called by session/config and physics-parameter setup paths.

operations.description: Capture the original value *a1 into the return slot before any clamping; this pre-clamp value is what the function returns.
Lower-bound guard: if *a1 < a2, clamp *a1 to the lower bound a2.
Upper-bound guard: else if *a1 > a3, clamp *a1 to the upper bound a3. (Hex-Rays reuses a2 as the write target in this branch via a2 = a3, a register-reuse artifact of the combined condition.)
Return the original *a1 value captured before clamping.
